notes.title: the next update will add lots of improvement
notes.content: So it's going to take a little bit longer :)

notes.title: Update 2.01
notes.content:
1.Fixed some bugs. thanks to @GambiGames
2.Added more procedural music

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32879520/387bc184a1043a11cbb7eafd84fb0c077f08eb51.png[/img]1.Fixed the problem the door could not enter
2. Add new mode - unlimited killing mode
3. A brand new rendering effect (the same as "the forest" renderer) is used to make the game more realistic and beautiful,you can close it in quality setting if your computer  is not good

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Added new mode --Relax mode

You can hear procedural generated  music on the infinite grassland, there are piano violins and all kinds of pure music,and it is never the same music  when you enter the game


Fixed some bugs in the dig mode

now you won't fall off the map

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
This version has set the day longer and reduced the materials needed to build the house
 the new Dig  mode has added, you can destroy the entire scene like Minecraft or dig caves to explore
